verdict.rationale: Codex documents running cloud tasks in parallel and starting and reviewing work from the web or CLI. The `codex cloud` command lets users browse active and completed chats, submit work, and apply results locally from one terminal interface, and summaries and diffs can be inspected per task. missing for 10: detailed documentation of a dedicated multi-session dashboard (e.g. how the desktop app organizes concurrent sessions), team-level visibility for a lead across engineers' sessions, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-session management.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Browse active and completed chats, submit work to a configured environment, and apply the result to your local repository from the terminal.
Run tasks in parallel without tying up your local machine.
Start and review work from the web or Codex CLI.
Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
